summary:
TerraScope: Earth System Trend Detective is an interactive data visualization platform designed to explore long-term changes in September Arctic sea ice extent from 1979 to 2026.

The project uses satellite-derived sea ice observations to investigate how Arctic sea ice has changed over time. It provides an interactive dashboard with historical trend visualization, year-by-year comparisons, statistical analysis, and access to the underlying dataset.

Using Python, statistical methods, and data visualization, TerraScope calculates the long-term trend and helps users understand the significance of Arctic sea ice decline. The project aims to make climate data easier to explore and interpret, helping students, researchers, and the public understand changes in Earth's cryosphere and their importance to the global climate system.
details:
1. Project Overview

TerraScope: Earth System Trend Detective is an interactive web-based platform that investigates long-term changes in September Arctic sea ice extent using satellite-derived observations.

The main objective is to make historical climate data accessible and understandable through interactive visualizations and statistical analysis.

2. How It Works

The project uses the September Arctic sea ice extent dataset from the National Snow and Ice Data Center (NSIDC).

The data is processed using Python to extract September observations, organize the historical records, and calculate trends.

The dashboard provides six main sections:

  • Overview: Displays key statistics and the overall historical trend.
  • Trend Explorer: Visualizes changes in Arctic sea ice extent over time.
  • Year Comparison: Allows users to compare sea ice extent across selected years.
  • Statistical Lab: Presents linear regression results, slope, R-squared, p-value, and decadal change.
  • Data Explorer: Provides searchable historical records and CSV downloads.
  • About: Explains the project, data source, and methodology.

3. Technologies Used

  • Python
  • Streamlit
  • Pandas
  • NumPy
  • Matplotlib
  • SciPy
  • Google Colab
  • GitHub
  • Streamlit Community Cloud

4. Benefits and Intended Impact

TerraScope transforms scientific observations into an accessible and interactive experience. It helps users identify long-term patterns, compare historical observations, and understand the statistical significance of changes in Arctic sea ice.

The project supports climate awareness and encourages data-driven exploration of Earth's changing environmental systems.

5. Creativity and Innovation

The project combines data analysis, statistical methods, and interactive visualization in one platform. Instead of presenting static charts, TerraScope allows users to explore the data, select years for comparison, examine statistical results, and download the underlying observations.

Its goal is to make climate science more understandable and engaging for a wider audience.
